categories.main_business_segments: Guangdong Haid Group primarily operates in the animal feed industry, producing and selling aquatic and livestock feed, premium aquatic animal seedlings, animal health products, and biological products. The company also engages in pig and aquatic product farming, covering R&D, design, production, sales, and services across these segments. Its core business segments include feed production, animal health (动保), breeding (种苗), farming (养殖), and related trade activities.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced animal genetics and breeding technologies, precise nutrition databases, microbial fermentation feed technologies, and feed additive applications. It employs a large R&D team focusing on animal nutrition, veterinary medicine, bioengineering, and healthy farming models. Production methods include multi-point localized manufacturing near major farming regions, integrated breeding and feed solutions, and factory-based shrimp farming with controlled environments.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Haid Group serves a broad customer base including large-scale family farms, integrated farming companies, and food enterprises involved in pig, poultry, and aquatic farming. Its products cater to domestic Chinese markets and international markets in Southeast Asia, South America, Africa, and others. Key customers are professional farmers requiring high-quality feed, seedlings, and health products to improve farming efficiency and product quality.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China, with major presence in South China, East China, North China, and Central China regions. Internationally, it has established manufacturing and sales operations in Southeast Asia (Vietnam, Indonesia, Bangladesh), South America (Ecuador), Africa (Egypt, Nigeria), and other emerging markets. Its global footprint supports a diversified market presence and risk mitigation.
categories.supply_chain_position: Guangdong Haid Group operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the animal husbandry supply chain. It produces feed and breeding stock, provides animal health products, and engages in farming operations. The company integrates upstream genetic breeding with downstream feed production and farming services, offering comprehensive solutions to end customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D investment in animal genetics, nutrition, disease resistance, and sustainable farming technologies. It focuses on developing high-performance feed formulas, microbial fermentation feed, antibiotic alternatives, and functional health feeds. Strategic initiatives include expanding integrated breeding-feed-health solutions, advancing factory-based aquaculture, and internationalizing its breeding and feed businesses.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of animal feed, breeding stock, animal health products, and farmed livestock and aquatic products. The company also earns income from trade activities related to raw materials and supplies. Its business model combines direct sales, localized production, and technical service support to customers, enhancing value through integrated solutions.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Haid Group is one of the leading feed producers in China and globally, ranking among the top three Chinese feed companies. It competes with other major domestic and international feed manufacturers, particularly in the highly competitive Chinese market and emerging overseas markets. The company differentiates itself through strong R&D capabilities, integrated breeding and health services, and extensive geographic coverage.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 114.6 billion, a slight decrease of 1.31% from 2023, with net profit attributable to shareholders increasing by 64.3% to about RMB 4.5 billion. Total assets grew by 7.58% to RMB 48.1 billion, and net assets increased by 21.67% to RMB 23.9 billion. The company showed strong profitability improvements and expanded market share domestically and internationally, with feed sales volume growing 8.7% to 26.5 million tons.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Guangdong Haid Group emphasizes its integrated 'feed + breeding + animal health' solution, leveraging advanced R&D and technical services to improve farming efficiency and animal health. Its products offer superior nutrition, disease resistance, and environmental adaptability, enabling customers to achieve higher survival rates and growth performance. The company’s localized production and service model, combined with strong innovation, create differentiated value and customer loyalty in competitive markets.
